effects over cohort only. By default, hetspec is timecohort.
    over(overspec) is part of StataNow. It specifies the subpopulation over which treatment effects are
      averaged for the twfe estimator. When covariates are specified, we need to control for their variation
      when computing treatment effects. The default is over(cohort), meaning effects are averaged over
      each cohort and adjusted for the time period effect. If there are no covariates, this option has no effect.
       When the heterogeneity type is specified as timecohort (hettype(timecohort)), overspec may

over() may not be specified with hettype(time).
    noxinteract is part of StataNow. It specifies that the covariates in omvarlist not be interacted with the
      difference-in-difference regressors in the TWFE model. Covariates are still included in the model as
      levels.

          SE/Robust
